description.add: Add the details for a new beerlog item.
description.edit: You can update the details below.

step1.title: Wait, are you sure?
step1.description: You're about to decrease your drink count. This seems suspicious... Are you really sure about this?

step2.title: Really though?
step2.description: Think carefully. Decreasing your count means you drank LESS. That's not the spirit! Last chance to reconsider.

step3.title: Final Warning!
step3.description: This is your last chance. Once you decrease, there's no going back. Are you absolutely, positively, 100% certain?

summerGames.title: Summer Games
summerGames.description: Configure the annual Summer Games period. During the period, the primary action becomes 'I was there', and the ranking counts participations instead of drinks.
summerGames.startDateHint: Leave empty to disable Summer Games. The period spans full ISO weeks starting with the week that contains this date.

summerGames.title: Summer Games
summerGames.description: Tap to log your participation for this week.

Hey {firstName},

Your account has been created and is waiting for approval. You will receive an email when you're ready to go...

approval.body:
Hey {firstName},

Good news - you can start using BeerLog now...

newUserRegistration.body:
Hey there,

A new user registered and is waiting to get approved.

passwordReset.subject: Password Reset Request
passwordReset.body:
Hello {firstName},

You have requested to reset your password for your BeerLog account.

Please click the following link to reset your password:
{resetLink}

This link will expire in {expiryHours} hours.

If you did not request this password reset, please ignore this email.
